rationale: Estimating the metabolic functions of the communities is done in this release by setting `--picrust true`, which adds the PICRUST process. In the baseline, QIIME2 runs, abundance tables are not skipped and a DADA2 reference taxonomy is set, so PICRUST takes the filtered QIIME2_EXPORT sequences and abundance table, and no upstream step changes. SUMMARY_REPORT reruns because it now also receives the PICRUSt2 pathway tables. MULTIQC reruns because the collated software versions now include PICRUST and the workflow summary now lists the changed parameter.
